prompt: Name a series that has won the Emmy for Outstanding Drama Series since 2000.
source: Television Academy, Outstanding Drama Series winners: https://www.televisionacademy.com/awards/nominees-winners
valueLogic: Game of Thrones, Breaking Bad and The Sopranos are named first by almost anyone. The middle band is the recent prestige run. The West Wing, Lost and 24 are the real tail - defining shows of the 2000s that a younger player may never have watched.
note: Dated with asOf, so a new winner is a correction to make next September, not a bust in waiting. Repeat winners count once. The Pitt's 2026 win is as supplied; verify it against the Television Academy before relying on it.

answers.name: Game of Thrones
answers.fact: Four wins - 2015, 2016, 2018 and 2019 - tied with The West Wing and Mad Men for the most this century.

answers.name: Breaking Bad
answers.fact: Won in 2013 and 2014, for its final two runs.

answers.name: The Sopranos
answers.fact: The first cable series ever nominated in the category, and won in 2004 and 2007.

answers.name: The Crown
answers.fact: Won in 2021, for its fourth season.

answers.name: The Handmaid's Tale
answers.fact: Won in 2017, the first streaming series to take the category.

answers.name: The West Wing
answers.fact: Four straight wins from 2000 to 2003, and the century's first winner.

answers.name: Homeland
answers.fact: Won in 2012, between the Mad Men and Breaking Bad runs.

answers.name: Lost
answers.fact: Won in 2005, for its first season.

answers.name: Shogun
answers.fact: Won in 2024, and the first largely non-English-language series to take it.
Won in 2006, and the only winner this century whose title is a number.

answers.name: The Pitt
answers.fact: The most recent winner, and the only show to take it in back-to-back years since Succession.

distractors.name: The Wire
distractors.note: Never won the category, and never even nominated for it.

distractors.name: The White Lotus
distractors.note: Competes as a drama but has not won this category.

distractors.name: Severance
distractors.note: Nominated, not a winner of this category.

distractors.name: The Bear
distractors.note: Competes as a comedy, not a drama.

distractors.name: Ted Lasso
distractors.note: A comedy winner, not a drama winner.

distractors.name: The X-Files
distractors.note: Nominated several times in the 1990s, but never won.
